name: Aiken County, SC
findings: Aiken County has 431 nonprofit organizations. 180 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 140 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Aiken County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Aiken County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: No education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
